entries.claim: Rust core and state are ready for public release
entries.stage_impact: Blocks beta+ if conformance or package dry-run is absent or failing
entries.counterexample: Rust core is production-ready without current CI and conformance evidence

entries.stage_impact: Blocks RC/1.0 stable multi-binding claims until per-binding checks and package dry-runs are green
entries.counterexample: Six stable bindings because package roots exist

entries.stage_impact: Blocks public benchmark claims at alpha+ unless raw outputs, fixtures, and commands are versioned together
entries.counterexample: Fastest or comparative benchmark graph without raw command, fixture IDs, and environment

entries.claim: Conformance fixtures support scheduler and binding claims
entries.stage_impact: Blocks beta+ claims outside ready fixture coverage
entries.counterexample: DES, ABM, hybrid, Arrow, or FFI fixture conformance while those fixture IDs remain planned

entries.stage_impact: Blocks RC/1.0 native or FFI safety claims unless scoped
entries.counterexample: Memory safe across all FFI bindings from one smoke lane

entries.claim: Docs maturity and public guidance are complete
entries.stage_impact: Blocks beta+ if docs imply features whose gate rows are not green
entries.counterexample: Docs claiming future binding or package availability as current

entries.claim: OpenSSF and supply-chain readiness are done
entries.stage_impact: Blocks RC/1.0 native artifacts without SBOM, checksum, and provenance evidence
entries.counterexample: SLSA/OpenSSF ready before generated artifacts are attached

entries.stage_impact: Blocks RC/1.0 for renamed or breaking public roots without ADR and migration note
entries.counterexample: Breaking package root rename presented as a minor release detail

entries.stage_impact: Blocks interoperability claims beyond documented mappings
entries.counterexample: Semantic compatibility with Mesa, Agents.jl, MASON, NetLogo, or DEVS tooling

entries.claim: Release artifact evidence exists for the current release train
entries.stage_impact: Blocks RC/1.0 claims about SBOM, provenance, or attestations; artifact/checksum claims are supported only for the local r2 dry-run evidence
entries.counterexample: Release notes saying SBOM, provenance, or hosted attestations are attached before those outputs exist
